latestVersion.changelog:
Ultimate Video 1.0.0 — first public release!

- Instantly edit and export complete videos by describing your desired result—no editing skills required.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB; AI handles enhancement and editing automatically.
- Connects to a cloud backend with simple, automatic authentication and session management.
- Supports common workflows: trim silences, add transitions, batch processing, timeline previews, and iterative edits.
- Clearly documents all supported commands, formats, usage tips, and error handling.
- Designed for content creators and marketers seeking a fast, professional finished product.
